description: Header file defining the OCIContainer class, which implements a JSONRPC server for container management within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It declares methods for container operations, event handlers, and interface implementations.

classes.name: OCIContainer
classes.description: A class implementing a JSONRPC server for container management, inheriting from PluginHost::IPlugin and PluginHost::JSONRPC, with methods for container operations and event handling.

methods.name: listContainers
methods.description: Lists all containers based on provided parameters.

methods.name: getContainerState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specified container.

methods.name: getContainerInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed information about a specific container.

methods.name: startContainer
methods.description: Starts a container with given parameters.

methods.name: startContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby specification.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.
